code: import{FINE_DAILY_RATE,DUE_DATE_DAYS}from'./constants';export function calculateDueDate(){let issueDate=arguments.length>0&&arguments[0]!==undefined?arguments[0]:new Date();const due=new Date(issueDate);due.setDate(due.getDate()+DUE_DATE_DAYS);return due;}export function isOverdue(dueDate){return new Date()>new Date(dueDate);}export function daysOverdue(dueDate){const now=new Date();const due=new Date(dueDate);if(now<=due)return 0;return Math.floor((now-due)/(1000*60*60*24));}export function calculateFine(dueDate){return daysOverdue(dueDate)*FINE_DAILY_RATE;}export function formatDate(date){return new Date(date).toLocaleDateString('en-US',{year:'numeric',month:'short',day:'numeric'});}
